📸 31-Jul Client Mobile Feedback — Visual Evidence & System Solutions
Finding #MOB-31-1 · Currency & Number Formatting
Real-Time Thousands Separator Comma Formatting as User Types
✓ 100% Verified Fixed
⚠️ BEFORE (Reported Screenshot 31-Jul Doc Image 1)
Client Feedback: "1. The amount i am typing should be in commas accordingly"
Issue Reported: Numbers entered into amount inputs (e.g. 1200000) are displayed as unformatted raw strings. User expects live commas (e.g. 1,200,000).
✅ AFTER (Verified System Solution)
Live Thousands Comma Formatting
Financing Requirement: PKR 1,200,000
System Solution: Implemented CurrencyInputFormatter that formats digits in real-time with thousands commas as user types, while payload serializer automatically strips commas before sending clean double values to REST backend.
Finding #MOB-31-2 · Native Camera & Gallery Execution
Actual Camera Capture & Photo Gallery File Selection Launch
✓ 100% Verified Fixed
⚠️ BEFORE (Reported Screenshot 31-Jul Doc Image 2)
Client Feedback: "2. While uploading docs, when i click on either photo or gallery it says attached even tho camera didnt open or neither the gallery opens"
Issue Reported: Tapping options in the upload bottom sheet closed immediately with dummy text without invoking device camera or file selector.
✅ AFTER (Verified System Solution)
📷 CNIC_Camera_Photo.jpg ✓ Attached
System Solution: Integrated image_picker package invoking native device camera (ImageSource.camera) and photo gallery (ImageSource.gallery), rendering thumbnail image preview and file size badge upon selection.
Finding #MOB-31-3 · CNIC & Mobile Sanitization & Masking
CNIC and Mobile Formatted Dash Input Sanitization & Validation Fix
✓ 100% Verified Fixed
⚠️ BEFORE (Reported Screenshot 31-Jul Doc Image 3)
Client Feedback: "3. Phone number and CNIC is ok but still keeps giving error"
Issue Reported: Entering formatted CNIC (e.g. 35201-1234567-1) or Mobile (e.g. 0300-1234567) failed strict regex length check because hyphens were counted as characters.
✅ AFTER (Verified System Solution)
✓ CNIC: 35201-1234567-1 (Valid 13 Digits)
✓ Mobile: 0300-1234567 (Valid 11 Digits)
System Solution: Added input formatters auto-inserting hyphens (CnicInputFormatter & MobileInputFormatter). Sanitizer strips non-digits before length check so formatted and unformatted inputs pass validation cleanly.
